CANNOT_DELETE_ASSIGNED_PERMISSION: The permission cannot be deleted because it is assigned to roles or users. Deactivate it instead.
CANNOT_DELETE_ROLE_WITH_USERS: The role cannot be deleted because it has users assigned. Deactivate it instead.
INVALID_PERMISSION_NAME_FORMAT: The permission name must follow the "resource:action" format (e.g. customers:read)
PERMISSIONS_NOT_FOUND_OR_INACTIVE: The following permission ids do not exist or are inactive: {missingIds}
ROLES_NOT_FOUND_OR_INACTIVE: The following roles do not exist or are inactive: {invalidRoles}
ROLE_ACTIVE_IN_USER_PROFILE: Role active in the user profile
USER_ID_NOT_EXISTS: The user with ID {userId} does not exist
USER_WITHOUT_PERMISSION: The user does not have the permission with ID {permissionId} assigned.
USER_WITHOUT_ROLE: The user does not have the role with ID {roleId} assigned.
